You can choose the medium of instruction to find out the available programs you are interested in. Please click on the dot on the available round to check the program info and requirements.
The First Semester refers to the September intake, and it is available for both undergraduate and postgraduate programs. The Second Semester refers to the February intake, it is available for postgraduate programs only.
